html:
Many people believe that the journey ends once the surgery is over. In reality, that is exactly where your new life begins!

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we believe that understanding your post-surgery diet is the most important step toward long-term success. If you are considering bariatric weight loss surgery in Ahmedabad, you might be wondering what your plate will look like in the coming weeks.

We follow a very careful, step-by-step plan to help your stomach heal properly while ensuring you get the nutrition you need. Take a look.

  • The Clear Liquid Phase

For the first few days after your procedure, we keep things very light. Your stomach is quite tender and needs time to rest. During this phase, we suggest clear liquids like plain water, coconut water, or thin dal water. The goal here isn’t calories; it is staying hydrated. We always tell our patients to take very small sips. Think of it like a bird drinking water.

  • Moving to Thick Liquids

Once we see that your body is comfortable, we move you to the thick liquid stage. This usually happens a week or two later. Now, you can enjoy things like thin lassi, strained vegetable soups, or milkshakes with no added sugar. We focus on protein during this time because protein helps your body repair itself. Even at this stage, we remind you to avoid using a straw, as it can push air into your stomach and cause discomfort.

  • The Soft Food Transition

After about three to four weeks, we start introducing soft, mashed foods. You can finally enjoy a bit of texture! Think of soft-boiled eggs, mashed papaya, or very soft khichdi. We want you to chew every single bite at least 20 to 30 times. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our doctors often say that your mouth should do the work that your stomach used to do.

  • Back to Healthy Solids

Eventually, you will return to eating regular healthy meals, but in much smaller portions. You will find that you feel full very quickly. We encourage our patients to always eat their protein first, like paneer, chicken, or pulses, before touching any carbs.

Conclusion

Silver Touch Hospitals is here to guide you through every meal and milestone. By choosing to undergo bariatric weight loss surgery in Ahmedabad at our facilities, you get a dedicated team to support your nutrition for years to come.
